decisions.reason: Tightening paragraph and section spacing does not change the existing font-type or font-size consistency rules.
The one-page cover-letter requirement from this source is already fully represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The streamlined document layout does not change the approved photo source, mandatory photo selection rule, or requirement to apply photos to the final draft.
The accepted streamlined layout and tighter spacing do not change the Blue Mesa Strategies identity, logo, or color requirements.
The spacing change intended to approach the page limit is already fully captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY Event.
The source changes general layout treatment and spacing but does not alter inclusion or placement of the organization chart.
A streamlined layout with tighter spacing does not remove or change the requirement to use the complete final draft as the content basis.
The source does not change the required tables, their approved source, or the five-table replacement instruction.
The layout and spacing decision does not change the biography count, affiliation, source, or direct-insertion method.
The visual-layout changes do not alter the requirement that all hyperlinks remain functional in the final file.
Reducing custom section treatments and tightening spacing do not change the fixed section order or permit reordering.
The streamlined layout decision does not affect Canva editing access, file ownership, link delivery, or the free-assets-only policy.
